title: Three introductions in three threads: three files, a card each

objects.subject: Arjun <> Tara Sethi (Quillstone Ventures)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Tara Sethi, a partner at Quillstone Ventures who backs early AI tools. Tara, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Arjun <> Dev Malhotra (Ferncrest)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Dev Malhotra, the COO of Ferncrest, a services firm whose ops team runs on follow-ups. Dev, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Arjun <> Anaya Kulkarni (Harborline)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Anaya Kulkarni, who leads partnerships at Harborline. Anaya, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Tara Sethi (Quillstone Ventures)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for the introduction. Before we find time, could you send me your deck? I'd like to read it ahead of a call.

Best,
Tara Sethi
Partner, Quillstone Ventures

exchange_intent.motive: read the deck before a call

questions.text: Can Arjun send Tara his deck before a call?
questions.quote: could you send me your deck?

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Dev Malhotra (Ferncrest)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Good to meet you. Our ops team is drowning in follow-ups. Could you show them the product in a 30-minute demo this Thursday or Friday?

Cheers,
Dev Malhotra
COO, Ferncrest

exchange_intent.motive: a demo for the ops team

questions.text: Can Arjun give Ferncrest's ops team a 30-minute demo on Thursday or Friday?
questions.quote: Could you show them the product in a 30-minute demo this Thursday or Friday?

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Anaya Kulkarni (Harborline)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Lovely to meet you. We host a founder roundtable on 20 August and would love you to speak for ten minutes on AI chiefs of staff. Could you let me know by Monday?

Warmly,
Anaya Kulkarni
Partnerships, Harborline

questions.text: Will Arjun speak for ten minutes at Harborline's founder roundtable on 20 August?
questions.quote: would love you to speak for ten minutes on AI chiefs of staff

implied_actions: answer Anaya about the roundtable by Monday
